segments.text: The report is forty pages. You've written zero. And just picturing all forty makes you so tired you check your phone instead.
Tracy's fix: don't eat the whole sausage. Cut one thin slice. Write the first paragraph. Just that.
Or punch one hole in it. Set a timer for ten minutes and do any part. That's the entire commitment.
Aim only for the next marker, never the whole road. Start small enough that starting feels easy, and momentum does the rest.
